idea-plugin.name: Spaghetti Code
idea-plugin.description:
Spaghetti Code untangles single-file websites.

AI tools love to generate an entire site in one giant index.html. Right-click it and choose Untangle Spaghetti to split the inline CSS and JavaScript into a clean folder structure, without changing how the page looks or behaves.

Works the same way on a standalone .css or .js file that has grown too large — split at its own section comments, rewritten as @import or side-effect import statements so nothing that already loads it needs to change. A classic (non-module) script, or a module other files import symbols from, is left alone with an explanation instead of a silent guess — see the plugin's README for why.

action.description: Split this file's inline (or, for a standalone .css/.js file, top-level) CSS and JavaScript into separate files
